summary: No change to the product code. Round 2's code at ee461d32 is what the tester verified, and its one failure was that the round carried no CI. The cause was not the skip-checks trailer: GitHub reported this pull request CONFLICTING with main, and it computes no merge ref for a conflicting head, so it ran no pull_request workflow at all. A forward merge of main (40e9841d) cleared the conflict, resolving three documentation conflicts, and CI was created for that head within a minute of the push.

proof.criterion: The round's head carries CI, so the static lanes, the reviewer's approval by SHA and the base's required checks have a run to read.
proof.surface: GitHub Actions on the pull request's branch and the pull request's own mergeability, read through the REST API as the reviewer and the daemon read them.
proof.command: gh pr view 2504 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus; jj git push of three heads that carry no skip-checks trailer (9c2ea00f empty, 5c47bed0 a handoff, 40e9841d the forward merge); gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/commits/<head>/check-runs --jq .total_count and gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs?branch=legion%2FINFRA-743'
proof.observed: Before the merge: mergeable=CONFLICTING, mergeStateStatus=DIRTY, and 0 check runs at ee461d32, f570b6fe, cfb7b124, at the trailer-free empty commit 9c2ea00f (19:29Z) and at the trailer-free handoff 5c47bed0 (19:36Z), while the repository's Actions were live for other branches at 19:25-19:27Z. After the merge: mergeable=MERGEABLE, and the runs 'CI' and 'PR Title' were created for 40e9841d at 19:56:17Z, within a minute of the push. At this writing PR Title is completed success and CI is queued; the daemon reads its result.
proof.negativeControl: The two trailer-free pushes before the merge are the control: an empty commit and a handoff commit, neither carrying skip-checks: true, both started nothing while the pull request was conflicting. That is what rules the trailer out as this round's cause and leaves the conflicting head as the cause, since the merge alone changed the outcome.

filesChanged: No product code changed. The branch gains 9c2ea00f (empty, no trailer), 5c47bed0 (this handoff's previous version, no trailer) and 40e9841d, the forward merge of main at 15be33d1.

The merge resolved three documentation conflicts: packages/envoy/docs/architecture.md keeps main's rewritten /v1/messages/publish row and this branch's /healthz row; packages/envoy/.changes/unreleased/pr-2362-replica-count.yaml and pr-2362-stream-byte-limit.yaml are deleted, as main deleted them when the changelog fold moved them into packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md.
trickyParts: A conflicting pull request gets no CI at all: GitHub computes no merge ref for it, so no pull_request workflow runs, and every push looks silently ignored. The skip-checks trailer on the head of a push is a second, independent way to get no run; both were in play this round, and only the conflict explains the zero runs at the trailer-free heads 9c2ea00f and 5c47bed0.

The two pr-2362 changelog fragments this change had corrected are now folded into packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md with their old sentence about the log line. The fold owns that file and a released entry records what shipped, so the deletion is taken rather than the CHANGELOG edited, as the INFRA-182 'repair failed' entry is left in the census. The corrected sentence stands where an operator reads it at runtime, in cmd/dispatch/settings.go's two descriptions.
deviations: The architect's task asked for one commit without the trailer and a read of the lanes. That alone did not start CI, because the cause was the conflicting head rather than the trailer; the forward merge was needed, and it is sanctioned for exactly this trigger (GitHub reporting CONFLICTING). Its fingerprints and resolutions are in the pull request's merge comment.
From this round on, every push of this issue that carries code ends on a commit without the trailer, and the handoff goes in a push of its own, as the architect directed.
discoveredComplexity: CI at 40e9841d was still queued when this handoff was written (PR Title completed success; CI queued since 19:56:17Z), the repository's runners being backed up. The daemon reads the result; nothing in this round waits for it.

Sibling contracts: from this round the implementer tells each sibling implementer itself whenever a shared contract changes. The round-2 /healthz change reached INFRA-594 from me and INFRA-514 and INFRA-590 from the tester; all three confirmed their resolutions in writing.
